scope.summary: Prove pinned character sheet plus PoseKit export through verify, lift, retarget, preview, apply, proxy/cloth drape, capture, receipt, and typed link-back, including all negative paths.
acceptance_criteria: Runs the pinned merged-main receipt through binding, evidence verification, camera/lift/retarget/contact proposal, native preview, manual amendment, selected apply, collider/cloth drape, capture, receipt, and Atelier-owned typed link-back.
Argus drives the real native GUI using the MT-718 ids and records AccessKit tree, screenshots, renderer error scan, Jobs/Problems/History state, cancellation, retry, and no-focus-steal evidence.

Negative rows cover unmerged or dirty source, failed containment/compatibility, tampered child hashes, unbound evidence, wrong character, stale sheet/body/skeleton, ambiguous camera/joints, rejected correction, cancellation at every phase, partial link-back failure, offline recovery, and idempotent replay.
This verification MT creates no GUI or second authority surface; it fails unless the backend and native workflow are both exercised against pinned fixtures and receipts.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-719 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: Backend-only tests can pass while the professional native workflow remains unusable, misleading, or unrecoverable.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > PoseKit and character-sheet interlinking

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
Two proof commands are intentional: the backend authority workflow and native Argus workflow are independent acceptance surfaces and both must pass.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
